Package domain

Interface PowerShot

All Superinterfaces:
Serializable
All Known Implementing Classes:
BlueAuraShot, IllusionShot, LightningShot, TornadoShot
public interface PowerShot extends Serializable
The unique power shot of a character (Strategy pattern). It decides how the ball leaves, how much damage it does and which effect it puts on the rival it hits. A new character only needs a new shot and a new effect.
Version:
1.0
Author:
Elian Ibarra, Oscar Poveda
